issues.summary: EyePoint's Duravyu misses its second phase 3 wet AMD trial and the company pivots to DME, plus new data on uveal melanoma prognostication and longitudinal OCTA in diabetes.
issues.coverage: Oct 19–20, 2026, plus two Oct 15 papers that earlier coverage missed

top.h: Duravyu misses noninferiority again in LUCIA, its second phase 3 wet AMD trial
EyePoint plans to end both wet AMD trials early, cut about 53% of staff, and prioritize DME
COOG2: 15-GEP/PRAME stays prognostic for uveal melanoma metastasis without confirmatory cytopathology

items.h: Duravyu misses noninferiority again in LUCIA, its second phase 3 wet AMD trial
items.ctx: The vorolanib insert (2.7 mg every 24 weeks; n=475) missed BCVA noninferiority vs aflibercept 2 mg every 8 weeks, as LUGANO did. Effect sizes were not disclosed.

items.h: LUCIA secondary endpoints: 38% lower treatment burden, 52% of eyes supplement-free through week 56
items.ctx: The 38% reduction vs aflibercept carried a nominal p<0.0001. EyePoint reports no drug-related safety signals across more than 630 patients in six trials.

items.h: EyePoint plans to end both wet AMD trials early, cut about 53% of staff, and prioritize DME
items.ctx: The COMO and CAPRI DME trials (n=551) are expected to read out in Q4 2027.

items.h: COOG2: cytopathology does not modify 15-GEP/PRAME prognostic accuracy in uveal melanoma
items.ctx: In 1,537 patients, metastasis outcomes did not differ by cytopathology within any GEP/PRAME class. Published Oct 15.

items.h: Three-year prospective OCTA study in type 2 diabetes finds small but significant longitudinal microvascular changes
items.ctx: The study followed 328 eyes imaged every 4 months vs 33 control eyes imaged yearly. The severe NPDR finding is exploratory (6 eyes). Published July 9; covered by Healio Oct 19.
